mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was worthwhile because it showed how the diaphragm separates them while nerves, vessels and the food pipe cross between regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempt to join the chest and lower body was confusing: their shapes suggested a fit, but the game required other preparations first.

surprise.text: I expected the chest and lower body to join immediately; the compatibility hint instead offered the arm and lymph network.

arbitrary.text: The need to fit the arm and lymph network before joining the chest to the lower body felt like an unexplained assembly prerequisite, even though the individual connections made sense.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a new connection in the body, but not just for more predictable assembly. The final cutaway was a good conclusion.
